summary: Feature request to add a standardized exception handler interface across all Temporal SDKs that allows applications to customize how workflow and activity failures are logged and telemetry is emitted.
userImpact: Users can customize how failures are logged and telemetry is emitted, allowing for more actionable error messages with application context without relying on correlation IDs.
proposedFix: Add a per-SDK exception handler interface invoked when a workflow or activity leaks an uncaught exception, allowing applications to customize failure logging and telemetry handling.
workaround: Use logging-framework filters or worker interceptors as temporary workarounds, but these don't handle all failure paths or require reliance on unstable SDK internals.
keyQuote: Adding an SDK exception handler interface that is called when an exception leaks would allow the application to provide actionable log messages.
